beats.caption: Astronomers just found the youngest world ever discovered.

beats.narration: Astronomers just found the youngest world ever discovered. It is still forming.

beats.caption: This planet is forming inside a cloud of debris.
beats.narration: It is forming right now inside a massive cloud of debris circling a young star.

beats.caption: This world is less than a million years old.
beats.narration: The planet is less than a million years old. In cosmic terms, that is a newborn.

beats.caption: Scientists have confirmed the planet exists.
beats.narration: Scientists have officially confirmed it exists, distinguishing it from the surrounding dust.

beats.caption: Studying it helps us understand how planets are made.
beats.narration: Seeing a planet this young gives us a rare look at how solar systems are built.
